parts.label: Complex oscillating vector dipole
parts.help: Complex conjugates, vector dipoles and real-part operations are outside this checker. Review the two conjugate cross terms and the sign convention.

parts.label: Mean transition power
parts.help: Use x = |a₂|², 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, and μ₂₁ for the positive norm of the transition dipole; other constants positive. Slowly varying populations, semiclassical model.

parts.label: Mean atomic energy
parts.help: Use x = |a₂|² and normalization |a₁|² = 1 − x; 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, E₂ > E₁.

parts.label: Lifetime parameter τsp
parts.help: Nonzero transition dipole; all listed scales positive. This is the lifetime parameter of the specified semiclassical equation.

parts.label: Excited-state population x(t)
parts.help: Use x₀ = |a₂(0)|², 0 < x₀ < 1, t ≥ 0, τ_sp > 0. For the sketch the initial amplitude 0.9 means x₀ = 0.81.

parts.label: Population sketch for initial amplitude 0.9
parts.help: Review x(0) = 0.81, the half-population time about 1.45τsp, and decay towards zero.

parts.label: Pure excited initial state
parts.help: Explain why this semiclassical model remains at x = 1 with zero radiated power, and why that is a limitation rather than a prediction of quantum spontaneous emission.

parts.label: Radiated-power pulse
parts.help: τ_sp, ℏ, ω₀ > 0; t₀ = τsp ln(x₀/(1−x₀)) is the half-population time. Pulse formula within the slowly varying semiclassical treatment.

parts.label: Power sketch for initial amplitude 0.9
parts.help: Review the initial rise, maximum at 1.45τsp, and subsequent decay; only t ≥ 0 is physical for the specified initial condition.
